user.title: Rain radar
user.description:
Pick the point to watch (it starts from the home location set in Home Assistant). Radar data comes from the Italian Civil Protection (Radar-DPC) every 5 minutes, with RainViewer as fallback outside Italy.

{avviso}

error.posizione_predefinita: This is Home Assistant's default location, not a real one: move the point on the map or set the home location in Settings → System → General.

data.nascondi_deboli: Hide weak echoes on the map

data_description.raggio: How many km around the point to analyse for distance, strongest rain and the map (20–150).
data_description.preavviso: "Rain incoming" turns on when the estimated arrival is within this many minutes.
data_description.distanza_arrivo: Rain counts as arrived when it is within this many km of the point (1–30). Used by "Rain arrival" and "Rain incoming".
data_description.nascondi_deboli: Echoes below 15 dBZ (drizzle or rain that does not reach the ground) are not drawn, in the card and the radar map image. Alerts and sensors do not change.
data_description.mappa: Background of the Radar map picture and of the card (unless the card sets its own). The provider's credits are shown under the map automatically.
